# Tauri Security — capabilities, scope and ACL permission control

Curated by Skill Harbor — @full-stack-skills' tauri-security: a Tauri v2 agent skill for capabilities, scope configuration and ACL-based permission control. Trigger phrases (capabilities, scope, acl, permissions file, plus Chinese equivalents) route the agent to: translate features into plugin capabilities, define scoped access rules per capability, generate and validate capabilities/default.json, and verify runtime behavior matches a minimum-privilege policy — capabilities and scope are mandatory controls in Tauri v2. Ships with a curated reference list to the official Tauri v2 security docs (capabilities, scope, ACL). Honest caveats: one of five topic-specific skills from the same repo (an umbrella Tauri router listing is already on the directory); the "gotchas" and Chinese "使用流程" sections are boilerplate shared across the series — the security-specific value is the trigger phrases, the how-to steps and the docs reference list. Bilingual EN/中文. Apache-2.0 licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
